data.name: 代号清风
data.detailed_description:
Contact Us

Add the game to your wishlist to stay updated with the latest news and announcements.


About the Game

Code Qingfeng is a cinematic interactive drama and spy-thriller AVG set in the shadow of 1947 Shanghai. Step into the role of an elite underground Party agent with extraordinary intellect, where you must outthink, outmaneuver, and outwit equally brilliant enemies in a deadly game of wits and deception.

Every choice carries weight. Ideals and reality, loyalty and betrayal, faith and sacrifice, love and loss, life and death—all hang in the balance, shaped entirely by your decisions.

Gameplay

  • Full voice acting, complete with story illustrations and cinematic cutscenes, delivering a movie-like immersive experience.

  • Branching narrative with timed choices; make quick, high-pressure decisions under pressure. Collect intelligence, analyze clues, and solve deep, layered mysteries.

  • Full achievement system to unlock special rewards and rare achievements for completionists.

Key Features

  • Three heroines, three major story branches, each with distinct fates and emotional arcs.

  • 6 complete endings + 1 true ending with exclusive hidden lore that redefines the entire conspiracy.

  • Dozens of critical choices and hundreds of branching options that dynamically alter the story.

  • High-stakes psychological battles and mind-bending puzzles as you unravel a massive, far-reaching plot.

  • Upcoming DLC expansions will explore additional character perspectives and expand the grand narrative.

Game Content & Playtime

  • Main story: 5+ hours

  • Full completion (all branches & endings): 12+ hours

  • Future character-focused DLC: 3+ hours per story pack

What Makes It Unique

  • Tense, high-stakes storytelling where danger lurks at every turn.

  • Sharp, intelligent writing with a cast of deeply strategic, quick-witted characters.

  • A sweeping conspiracy with shocking twists that will leave you stunned by the finale.

  • Deep emotional drama exploring faith, sacrifice, love, and human conviction.

  • Fully voiced in Simplified Chinese with immersive cinematic presentation.

This is not just a story—it’s a battle of minds, a test of loyalty, and a journey into the heart of a revolution few dared to imagine.
